mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_name, u.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, u.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, u.role, u.active, u.created_at FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = u.vendor_id ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_name, u.department_id, d.department_code, d.department_name, u.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, u.role, u.active, u.created_at FROM app_user u LEFT JOIN department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.vendor_id = u.vendor_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user
AND active = #{active}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE active = #{active}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (login_id, password, user_name, department_id, vendor_id, role, active) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{userName}, #{departmentId}, #{vendorId}, #{role}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET active = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE app_user SET department_id = #{departmentId} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
